observed_branch_scope: The affected build emitted -1113 only when the manager+72 descriptor read was null or its word 5 differed from 0x0C709E91. The device display alone does not distinguish those two branches.
root_cause: EVID-BT-1043-PAIR-FILTER-002 misread adapter+120 as a client with a descriptor pointer at +72. Exact IDB re-audit proves adapter+120 points to a callbacks_list manager allocated by sub_C3A9688 with size 0x24. sub_C3A96EC separately allocates and returns an 8-byte registration node {cookie, descriptor}; dword_20126734 is that node pointer and node+4 owns off_2CD4A744. Reading or writing manager+72 is therefore out of bounds and caused the pre-bond policy failure, with possible heap corruption if the accidental slot check ever passed.

negative_abi_assumptions.reason: adapter+120 is a 0x24-byte callbacks_list manager; +72 is outside the allocation and is not a descriptor field

negative_abi_assumptions.expression: core_bt_registration_handle is an opaque token unrelated to descriptor ownership
negative_abi_assumptions.reason: sub_C3A96EC returns the exact 8-byte registration-node pointer and sub_C3A9770 removes that same pointer

corrective_action: Validate the exact registration node, create a resident 17-word mirror, register it through the firmware API, unregister the original node, and update dword_20126734 only after both operations succeed. Keep descriptor identity and Pair Request slot checks fail-closed.

diagnostic_split.-1115: registration cookie or descriptor identity mismatch
diagnostic_split.-1117: firmware mirror registration or original-node removal failure

required_checks: Never write an internal manager offset unless allocation bounds and a writer/reader lifecycle prove that field.
Treat registration return values as candidate ownership objects and trace their allocator, fields, lookup predicate, and destructor before classifying them as opaque handles.
Keep module-local diagnostics separate from firmware bt_create_bond return values.
Do not mark the correction device-verified until an exact-target retest passes.
